checks.name: Additive bench save preserves household, money, belongings and daily life
Each player holds a distinct end; move and turn controls contribute independently
Safe drop, role swap and interrupted-carry reload release both players without losing the bench
Swept collision prevents wall tunnelling and reset restores a safe checkpoint
Complete gate / generator / courtyard / veranda route is traversable with bench and both holders
Placement needs two approvals, changing the proposal clears consent, and reload preserves the committed choice
Both existing rigs sit on the bench; saving seated characters retains safe standing resume positions
Three complete deliveries succeed; replay cannot duplicate money, items or the first bench memory
Rebuilding is idempotent; finite bench meshes and activity UI are available

method: Shipped Three.js runtime, full compound collisions, keyboard input roles, saves, seating and three controlled deliveries in Node. Cloud preview cannot create WebGL; no rendered or human playtest claim.
